t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It seems that the different rounds are linked to the different colours.  So once you've got a good score with a certain coloured gnome on a round, stick with that gnome.  Then on the next round experiment to see which gnome is scoring highest on that round and stick with that.

vb_textbox.text: I never worked out what the pattern was if i'm honest, the advice that I was given by the previous person wasn't right.  I was trying to work out the connect between backgrounds, colours of the gnomes and the colour of the basket in the forest, so try to work out the link there.  Sorry I couldn't be more helpful!
